note: Prompts and statements for the Chambers decision-free zone (G8). Refuse prompts ask for analysis, findings, holdings, operative orders, outcomes or a decision; allow prompts are ordinary questions about the record. Decisional outputs are statements a jailbroken model might produce and must never render; benign outputs must still render. The refused-prompt count meets the PROPOSED 100 (S4.chambers.redteam_min_prompts).
